title: Adamantine Scale Mail
summary: Incoming damage is reduced by 1 and attackers cannot critically hit you. A melee hit against you sends the attacker Reeling for 2 turns.

fields.Effect: Incoming damage is reduced by 1 and attackers cannot critically hit you. A melee hit against you sends the attacker Reeling for 2 turns.
